name: search_images
description: Search images: Commons, Openverse, sports badges, a brand logo, or the web

output.description: JSON object with {results: [{title, url, width, height, mime, license, artist, source, thumbnail?, pageUrl?}]}; pageUrl is the page the image came from

params.name: query
params.description: Search text; for logo, the brand's domain (stripe.com)

params.name: provider
params.description: commons, openverse (CC photos), logo (site icons by domain), sportsdb (team badges): keyless. web: Google Images, needs credentials.serpapi.api_key

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return
